description: This Python source file defines a configuration class for interfacing with Bedrock Stability AI Image Edit API, including methods for parameter mapping, request transformation, response handling, and environment validation. It supports Stability models and provides mechanisms to convert OpenAI-compatible requests and responses to Bedrock API formats.

classes.name: BedrockStabilityImageEditConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Bedrock Stability AI image edit operations, including model validation, parameter mapping, request and response transformations, and environment validation.

methods.description: Checks if a given model string corresponds to a Bedrock Stability edit model based on naming patterns.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameters supported for a specific model.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, image_edit_optional_params: ImageEditOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI image edit parameters to Bedrock Stability API parameters, handling supported parameters and conversions.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict,Any] transform_image_edit_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, image: FileTypes, image_edit_optional_request_params: Dict, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms an OpenAI-style image edit request into Bedrock Stability API request format, including image encoding.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_edit_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms Bedrock Stability API response into an OpenAI-compatible ImageResponse object, extracting images and handling errors.

methods.name: bool use_multipart_form_data(self)
methods.description: Indicates whether the API uses multipart/form-data; returns False as Bedrock uses JSON.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs or returns the API endpoint URL; in Bedrock's case, a placeholder since URL is managed elsewhere.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets necessary headers for the Bedrock environment, primarily ensuring proper content type and AWS credentials management.
